title: rig_config v1
description: Declared physical/optical layout of one rig (rigs/<rig_id>/rig.yml): projection paths and camera mounts. Camera fields are expectations that producers' readbacks (Orange camera_geometry_v1) are checked against, not applied state; camera-to-arena assignment is Citrus registered geometry and is not here. Every physical field is a declared value or the string 'unknown'. derived.* fields are products computed by rigconfig.py and checked by tests; rules in rigs/README.md. Host inventory (NIC, IP, lens, sensor) is not here; cameras join to the host config by serial_number.

rig_geometry_revision.description: Bumped whenever any physical field changes, including unknown -> declared. rigs/<rig_id>/revisions.json pins the physical digest of each revision.

last_physical_change.description: Date the hardware was last physically changed (not the date of the declaration).

projection_paths.description: Keyed by a path id (e.g. main). A host binds each path to one display output.

cameras.description: Keyed by camera serial_number as a string, the only join key to host inventory.

projection_mode.description: Physical geometry relative to the reference view (dish seen from above): front = projector light reaches the image surface from above; rear = from below, image seen through the surface. Not the projector menu setting. Rear = -1.

projector_mount.description: Physical body orientation (upright vs inverted). A rotation: parity +1.

projector_firmware_flip.description: Net mirroring set in the projector menu (README maps BenQ Projector Position to this). horizontal/vertical = -1; both (= 180 rotation) = +1.

optical_mirror_count.description: Fold mirrors between projector lens and image surface. Odd = -1.

projector_settings.description: Projector menu state that changes where or how the canvas lands; part of the physical digest. Vocabulary is the BenQ X3100i menu (user manual v1.00 pp. 45-46; RS-232 table pp. 60-64). rigconfig checks position_effective against projector_firmware_flip.

position_menu.description: Installation > Projector Position as shown in the menu (Auto/Front/Front Ceiling/Rear/Rear Ceiling). RS-232 names Front and Rear 'Front Table' and 'Rear Table'.

position_effective.description: The position actually applied: equals position_menu unless that is auto, when the projector chooses at power-on. RS-232 *pp=?# reads it. Maps to projector_firmware_flip: front none, rear horizontal, front_ceiling both, rear_ceiling vertical.

upscaling_4k.description: Display > 4K Upscaling (XPR pixel shift on all timings). No RS-232 read command.

keystone_h.description: Installation > 2D Keystone H (RS-232 *hkeystone=?#). Non-zero warps the canvas.

keystone_v.description: Installation > 2D Keystone V (RS-232 *vkeystone=?#). Non-zero warps the canvas.

digital_zoom_percent.description: Game Settings > Digital Zoom, 100 = off. No RS-232 read command.

brightness.description: Picture > Brightness (0-100). Optional: changes how bright the canvas is, not where it lands. Physical when present.

contrast.description: Picture > Contrast (0-100). Optional; physical when present.

sharpness.description: Picture > Sharpness. Optional; physical when present. The manual states no range.

input_source.description: Source / input as the menu names it (e.g. HDMI-1). Optional; physical when present: the projector keeps a picture mode per input.

picture_mode.description: Picture > Picture Mode as the menu names it (e.g. User). Optional; physical when present.

gamma.description: Picture > Advanced Color Settings > Gamma Selection (RS-232 *gamma=?#). Optional; physical when present.

color_temperature.description: Picture > Advanced Color Settings > Color Temperature (RS-232 *ct=?#). Optional; physical when present.

light_source_mode.description: Picture > Advanced Color Settings > Light Source Mode (RS-232 *lampm=?#; LNOR = normal). Optional; physical when present.

hdmi_signal_format.description: Display > HDMI Settings > Signal Format: the quantization range the projector assumes (no RS-232 read). Optional; physical when present.

color_temperature_tuning.description: Picture > Advanced Color Settings > Color Temperature Tuning (RS-232 *RGain=?# ... *BOffset=?#; neutral is 100 and 256). Optional; physical when present.

white_balance.description: Picture > Advanced Color Settings > Color Management > White Balance (RS-232 *WRGain=?# ...). Optional; physical when present.

color_management.description: Picture > Advanced Color Settings > Color Management, per primary {hue, saturation, gain} (RS-232 reads only the selected primary: *primcr=?#, *hue=?#, *saturation=?#, *gain=?#). Optional; physical when present.

evidence.description: Who declared this field group, when, and on what evidence (menu wording, photo, measurement, document).

canvas_space_parity.description: projection_mode x projector_firmware_flip x (-1)^optical_mirror_count: citrus.display_canvas_px (as scanned out, xrandr output unreflected) relative to the canvas as it lands on the dish seen from above. Excludes Citrus's OpenGL presentation reflection and the session's xrandr reflection; Citrus composes those.

nominal_geometry.description: Optional. Nominal projector geometry; consumed by no runtime today. Physical: a change bumps rig_geometry_revision.

lens_nadir_canvas_px.description: Canvas pixel straight above the lens front glass. NOT where the optical axis lands; not a principal point.

lens_glass_to_film_mm.description: Vertical distance from the lens front glass to the film.

display_mode.description: Optional. The video mode the host drives this projection path at; canvas pixels are in width_px x height_px. Citrus refuses START when the live output mode differs. Physical: a change bumps rig_geometry_revision.

stimulus_render_rate_hz.description: Optional. Frames per second the stimulus program (Citrus) renders on this path. When an integer, display_mode.refresh_rate_hz must be a number within 0.05 Hz of a whole multiple of it (rigconfig.validate; not expressible in JSON Schema). Citrus refuses to open its stimulus window when it is missing or unknown. Physical: a change bumps rig_geometry_revision.

projector_operation.description: Optional projector settings that change how it powers on, which input it shows or how it identifies itself, not the light on the canvas. Outside the physical digest (no revision bump); changes go in the events ledger. BenQ X3100i vocabulary.

qs02_media_streaming.description: System > Operation Settings > BenQ HDMI Media Streaming (QS02). On shows a 'dongle not detected' notice at power-on that waits for OK. No RS-232 read.

quick_auto_search.description: Display > Auto Source Search (RS-232 *QAS=?#). On lets the projector switch inputs when its input loses signal.

direct_power_on.description: System > Operation Settings > Power On/Off Settings > Direct Power On (RS-232 *directpower=?#).

auto_power_off.description: System > Operation Settings > Power On/Off Settings > Auto Power Off, minutes without signal. No RS-232 read.

hdmi_edid.description: Display > HDMI Settings > EDID for the input in use: Enhanced (HDMI 2.0, needed for 240 Hz) or Standard (HDMI 1.4, up to 1080p60). Changes the EDID the projector sends, so the host's saved EDID (docs/display_and_projector_edid.md) must change with it. No RS-232 read.

viewing_side.description: Expected side of the dish the optical path leaves toward the camera (before any fold mirror). ventral = -1.

optical_mirror_count.description: Fold mirrors between dish and camera. Odd = -1.

reverse_x.description: Expected camera ReverseX, the value Orange's sealed readback is checked against. true = -1; false and not_supported_by_firmware (the camera has no ReverseX node, so it cannot flip) = +1.

reverse_y.description: Expected camera ReverseY, the value Orange's sealed readback is checked against. true = -1; false and not_supported_by_firmware (the camera has no ReverseY node, so it cannot flip) = +1.

rotation_deg.description: Expected software rotation before recording, checked against Orange's readback. A rotation: parity +1.

evidence.description: Who declared this field group, when, and on what evidence (menu wording, photo, measurement, document).

recorded_space_parity.description: viewing_side x (-1)^optical_mirror_count x reverse_x x reverse_y: camera.recorded_px relative to the dish seen from above.

expected_camera_to_canvas_handedness.description: Keyed by projection path id: preserved when recorded_space_parity x that path's canvas_space_parity = +1, reflected when -1. Per path rather than per arena: which canvas region a camera sees is Citrus's registered geometry. Assumes an unreflected xrandr output.

nominal_geometry.description: Optional. Nominal mount geometry for the deferred parallax model; consumed by no runtime today. Physical: a change bumps rig_geometry_revision. Scale stays in Citrus calibration.

height_above_gel_mm.description: Nominal distance from the lens entrance pupil to the gel surface along the optical axis.

optical_axis_tilt_from_nadir_deg.description: Nominal angle between the optical axis and the vertical (0 = looking straight down/up).

id.description: Stable handle; arena overrides name it.

part_id.description: hardware_library part id; omitted while there is none.

thickness_mm.description: Along the vertical. For the last layer (the water the fish swims in) this is the nominal water depth; the per-recording fill goes in session metadata.

refractive_index_source.description: Where a declared index comes from (free text, not in the digest).

evidence.description: Who declared this field group, when, and on what evidence (menu wording, photo, measurement, document).

mediaStack.description: Optional. Layers light crosses from the projector to the fish, in order; exactly one film layer (the projected surface); the last layer is the water the fish swims in. Physical: a change bumps rig_geometry_revision (evidence, refractive_index_source and derived do not). rigs/README.md#media-stack.

air_between_film_and_fish.description: false: no layer after the film may be air (checked).

arenas.description: Arena id -> {layer id -> overrides}; {} when the arena uses the shared stack.

part_id.description: hardware_library part id; omitted while there is none.

assumptions.description: Not built facts, but they feed derived, so they are in the digest.

fish_eye_height_above_dish_floor_mm.description: ASSUMED height of the fish eye above the floor of the last layer.

support.description: Optional. The dish hangs from a fixed datum (e.g. winglets on the holder rim) rather than resting on the layers below it. Needs holder_top_above_film_mm or dish_floor_above_film_mm. Physical except evidence. rigs/README.md#media-stack.

holder_top_above_film_mm.description: Height of the datum the dish hangs from (e.g. the holder top its winglets rest on) above the film's fish-side face. A rig fact. The dish floor is this minus the dish's own seat-to-floor drop, derived per arena by the consumer from the dish in that arena (Citrus: dish_floor_above_image_plane_mm).

dish_floor_above_film_mm.description: Height of the top of the dish floor (the floor of the fish's water) above the film's fish-side face. Declare it only when the floor does not depend on which dish is used; otherwise declare holder_top_above_film_mm and let the consumer derive the floor. With it, eye_to_film_mm = this + the assumed eye height, whatever the dish base.

fill_layer.description: Id of the layer between the film and the fish's water whose thickness is what the support height leaves over (checked: the layers between the film and the fish's water sum to dish_floor_above_film_mm when all are known).

evidence.description: Who declared this field group, when, and on what evidence (menu wording, photo, measurement, document).
Who declared this field group, when, and on what evidence (menu wording, photo, measurement, document).

derived.description: Per arena, computed by rigconfig.py: eye_to_film_mm (geometric) and eye_to_film_paraxial_mm (n_eye * sum(t_i/n_i)).

roomOrientation.description: Optional. Canvas axes in the operator's frame: standing at the door, looking at the rig from above. Physical except evidence. rigconfig checks the two axes are different room axes.

projector_offset_toward.description: Horizontal side of the canvas the projector body sits toward.

evidence.description: Who declared this field group, when, and on what evidence (menu wording, photo, measurement, document).
